---
title: "Generate File Upload Url"
description: "Generates an upload URL to allow external clients to upload a file to the Media Manager."
icon: "upload"
mode: "wide"
---

<span className="wix-method wix-method-post">POST</span>

<Tabs>

  <Tab title="REST">

    <div className="wix-api-columns">

    <div className="wix-ref">

    Generates an upload URL to allow external clients to upload a file to the Media Manager. <br />

    Learn how to use the generated upload URL to [upload a file to the Media Manager](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/upload-api).
    <Note>

    - When you upload a file, it's not immediately available, meaning you can't manage or use the file straight away. Learn more about [knowing when a file is ready](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/importing-files).
    - Any interruption in the upload process stops the file upload. For files larger than 10MB, or when network connection is poor, call Generate File Resumable Upload URL instead. With the resumable upload URL, any interruption in the upload process pauses the file upload, and resumes the file upload process after the interruption.

    </Note>

    <Note>

      **Authentication**

      You can only call this method when authenticated as a Wix app or Wix user [identity](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/articles/authentication/about-identities).

    </Note>

    ## Permissions

    This method requires one of the following permission scopes:

    <div className="wix-scopes">

    <span className="wix-scope" title="SCOPE.DC-MEDIA.MANAGE-MEDIAMANAGER">Manage Media Manager</span>

    </div>

    Learn more about [app permissions](https://dev.wix.com/docs/build-apps/develop-your-app/access/authorization/about-permissions).

    Callable by: `APP`.

    ## Endpoint

    ```http
    POST https://www.wixapis.com/site-media/v1/files/generate-upload-url
    ```

    ## Body Params

    <ParamField body="mimeType" type="string" required>

      File mime type.

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="fileName" type="string">

      Temporary file name used to identify the file type. For example, a file named "myFile.jpeg" identifies as an "image/jpeg" file type.
      &lt;br /> **Notes:** &lt;ul> &lt;li>The name that appears in the Media Manager is taken from the `fileName` parameter in the Generate File Upload Url call.&lt;/li> &lt;li>If you specify a `fileName`, the `filename` query parameter in the upload request itself is not required. &lt;/li> &lt;/ul>
      The file name is truncated to 255 characters if longer.

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="sizeInBytes" type="string">

      File size in bytes.

      **Read-only.**

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="parentFolderId" type="string">

      ID of the file's parent folder. &lt;br />
      This folder is the path root for the `filePath`.&lt;br />
      Default: `media-root`.

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="private" type="boolean">

      Whether the file will be public or private. Learn more [about private files](https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/assets/media/media-manager/files/private-files).

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="labels" type="string[]">

      Labels assigned to media files that describe and categorize them. Provided by the Wix user, or generated by [Google Vision API](https://cloud.google.com/vision/docs/drag-and-drop) for images.

      Constraints: `maxLength 200`, `maxItems 50`.

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="externalInfo" type="ExternalInfo">

      A place to map an external entity to an uploaded file in the Wix Media Manager.

      <Expandable title="externalInfo properties">

        <ParamField body="origin" type="string">

          External information to specify in the File Ready or File Failed events.

          Constraints: `maxLength 1000`.

        </ParamField>

        <ParamField body="externalIds" type="string[]">

          External IDs to specify in the File Ready or File Failed events.

          Constraints: `maxLength 4000`, `maxItems 30`.

        </ParamField>

      </Expandable>

    </ParamField>

    <ParamField body="filePath" type="string">

      Path to the folder where the file will be stored.
      For example, `/videos/2024/december`. &lt;br/>
      If `parentFolderId` is defined, the parent folder is used as the path root. Otherwise, the root is `media-root`.
      The folders in the path will be created if they don't already exist.  &lt;br />

    </ParamField>

    ## Response Object

    <ResponseField name="uploadUrl" type="string">

      The URL for uploading a file to the Media Manager.

      Constraints: `format WEB_URL`.

    </ResponseField>

    ## Errors

    | Status | Code | Application code | Description |
    | --- | --- | --- | --- |
    | `400` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `MISMATCH_MIME_TYPE` | MIME type doesn't match the file extension. |
    | `400` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `ZERO_FILE_SIZE` | File size is 0 bytes. |
    | `400` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `UNSUPPORTED_FILE_FORMAT` | File format is recognized but not supported. |
    | `400` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `FILE_SIZE_OVER_LIMIT` | File size exceeds the limit for this media type. |
    | `400` | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `SITE_QUOTA_EXCEEDED` | Site quota has been exceeded. |

    <Note>

      This method may also return standard errors. [Learn more about standard Wix errors](https://dev.wix.com/docs/rest/articles/getting-started/errors).

    </Note>

    </div>

    <div className="wix-examples">

    ## Examples

    <CodeGroup>

      ```bash Request
      curl -X POST \
        'https://www.wixapis.com/site-media/v1/files/generate-upload-url' \
        -H 'Authorization: <AUTH>' \
        -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
        --data-binary '{
          "mimeType": "image/jpeg",
          "fileName": "T-shirt.jpg",
          "sizeInBytes": "2608831",
          "parentFolderId":"25284aa06584441ea94338fdcfbaba12",
          "private": false,
          "labels": ["AMS:external_file_id", "woman", "bicycle"]
        }'
      ```

      ```json Response
      {
        "uploadUrl": "https://upload.wixmp.com/upload/bnfhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..Z-R2i-w9YzBH4vkkP3RjaXaqj-QPnu-cyvQd5h_oTyE"
      }
      ```

    </CodeGroup>

    </div>

    </div>

    <div className="wix-picker-panels">

    <div className="wix-picker-panel">

    ```javascript Generate a file upload url
    import { files } from '@wix/media';

    /* Sample mimeType value: 'image/jpeg'
     * Sample options value:
     * {
     *   fileName: 'image1.jpeg',
     *   parentFolderId: '103601562ec94214bee61f470b403dd5',
     *   labels: ['nature', 'outdoors']
     * }
     */

    async function myGenerateFileUploadUrlFunction(mimeType, options) {
      try {
        const result = await files.generateFileUploadUrl(mimeType, options);

        const url = result.uploadUrl;
        return url;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        // Handle the error
      }
    } 

    /* Promise resolves to:
     * {
     *   "uploadUrl": "https://upload.wixmp.com/upload/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pd9ZssMw0NOTIxmNm0gm3r5WP6ySCy4vBxlT8ufU_Vw"
     * }
     */
    ```

    </div>

    <div className="wix-picker-panel">

    ```javascript Generate a file upload url (with elevated permissions)
    import { files } from '@wix/media';
    import { auth } from '@wix/essentials';

    const elevatedGenerateFileUploadUrl = auth.elevate(files.generateFileUploadUrl);

    /* Sample mimeType value: 'image/jpeg'
     * Sample options value:
     * {
     *   fileName: 'image1.jpeg',
     *   parentFolderId: '103601562ec94214bee61f470b403dd5',
     *   labels: ['nature', 'outdoors']
     * }
     */

    async function myGenerateFileUploadUrlFunction(mimeType, options) {
      try {
        const result = await elevatedGenerateFileUploadUrl(mimeType, options);

        const url = result.uploadUrl;
        return url;
      } catch (error) {
        console.error(error);
        // Handle the error
      }
    } 

    /* Promise resolves to:
     * {
     *   "uploadUrl": "https://upload.wixmp.com/upload/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..pd9ZssMw0NOTIxmNm0gm3r5WP6ySCy4vBxlT8ufU_Vw"
     * }
     */
    ```

    </div>

    <div className="wix-picker-panel">

    ```javascript Use a file upload url in an external node.js application
    /********************************
     * External Node.js application *
     *******************************/

    import axios from 'axios';

    /* Sample fileName value: 'video1.mp4'
     * Sample contentType value: 'video/mp4'
     * Sample videoToUpload value: 'path/to/yourVideo.mp4'
     */

    async function myUploadVideoFunction(generatedUploadUrl, videoToUpload, fileName, contentType) {
      const response = await axios.put(generatedUploadUrl, videoToUpload, {
        headers: {
          'Content-Type': contentType
        },
        params: {
          filename: fileName
        }
      });

      return `${response[0].uploadUrl}`;
    }
    ```

    </div>

    <div className="wix-picker-panel">

    ```javascript generateFileUploadUrl (self-hosted)
    import { createClient } from '@wix/sdk';
    import { files } from '@wix/media';
    // Import the auth strategy for the relevant access type
    // Import the relevant host module if needed

    const myWixClient = createClient ({
      modules: { files },
      // Include the auth strategy and host as relevant
    });

    async function generateFileUploadUrl(mimeType,options) {
      const response = await myWixClient.files.generateFileUploadUrl(mimeType,options);
    };
    ```
